role: E2-to-E3 integration test harness: persistence-based multi-hop semantic inference without Neo4j dependency.
detail: Provides PersistenceInferenceTraverser, a test infrastructure class that mirrors InferenceQueryExecutor's BFS logic but queries edges through the GraphPersistence protocol instead of Cypher. Enables E2->E3 integration validation where guardian teaching (assert_fact, E2) populates the semantic graph and semantic queries (E3) verify multi-hop inference. execute() resolves subject/target nodes, runs bounded BFS traversal, detects cycles, prunes by confidence floor (MIN_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.3), limits depth (max_depth=3 default), builds ReasoningStep chains, and records SemanticInferenceTrace nodes. _traverse() performs BFS queue-based frontier expansion across INFERENCE_TRAVERSABLE_EDGE_TYPES with visited set cycle detection and depth_limit_reached flag. _query_neighbors() fetches outgoing edges via persistence.query_edges(), skips deprecated/expired edges, sorts by confidence descending. _path_to_steps() converts edge path to ReasoningStep list with hop indices and confidences. _record_trace() delegates to InferenceTraceWriter to persist A.19-compliant SemanticInferenceTrace with reasoning chain and termination reason. Validates CANON A.1 (guardian provenance), A.11 (edge provenance), A.18 (TAUGHT_PROCEDURE bootstrap), A.19 (trace recording), A.20 (DENOTES cross-domain traversal).
gotchas: DENOTES edge traversal hardcoded False in result (denotes_traversed=False lines 194, 275); run_e2_e3_integration test function declared in module docstring but not implemented in file; this is test infrastructure only, not for production use (line 27-28)
